verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, so asking about headless or CI automation is fair, but nothing in the evidence shows it can run headlessly or inside a CI pipeline. The closest documented features are Shortcuts and x-callback-url automation and Auto-Sync or Background Sync. These are on-device automation features of the interactive app, not a headless or CI execution mode, so they are only adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
